narration.text: Part B taken up through the special period the month a job ends, starting the day the employer coverage stops, with no lifetime penalty, and a spouse on retiree coverage told why she must wait. This is a chore for a worker of 67 retiring at the end of the month who never took Part B, managing Medicare for himself and, with her permission, his wife. Athena works it across 4 portals: Mailnest, Staffnest HR, Thistlewood Health and Benefitline. On the bench, she found 2 of 2 eligible items, worth 487 dollars of the 487 dollars there was to find. All 2 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 88 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
